overview:
Chapter 10 begins the chain of descent, the *seder hishtalshelus*, from the top down. It looks first at the source: the light of the *Ein Sof* before the first *tzimtzum*, which is simple light, and the ten *sefiros* included in G-d's unity. Its three levels, *yachid*, *echad* and *kadmon*, are three ways we can relate to that unity, not three parts of it.

To make an essence understandable, the chapter uses *meshalim* from the soul. The *yechida* is the essence of the soul, from which the faculties come out. A kind person's desire for kindness is a raw potential, the *hiyuli*, which holds all its later details in one. The power of movement and the power of consciousness show the same thing: the essence contains its expressions and is not separate from them, and the differences come from the vessels. The sun and its light set up a *makif* and a *pnimi*.

The chapter then spells out the three stages: the ten essential powers, their readiness to be revealed, and their complete preparation before action. Examples of practice and of a seed show what lies between potential and act, and why that jump needs *tzimtzum*.

blocks.text: The first nine chapters were an introduction. From chapter 10 to the end of the book the Mitteler Rebbe explains the *seder hishtalshelus*, the whole process of creation from the top down. First, a recap of what those chapters asked us to keep in mind through the rest of the book.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 057 ch 10 intro recap.mp3

blocks.outOfPlace: Recap of chapters 1-9 given before chapter 10 is read; it sets out how to study the chain of descent.

blocks.text: *Hisbonenus* (contemplation) means studying a topic in depth, and *iyun* is that close analysis. Working on tangible examples is *binah*, and through it we reach the more abstract grasp of *chachma* and new insights. Understanding also unlocks *daas*, the sense of how an idea is personally relevant to you, with the personal interest and attachment that the idea needs in order to affect you. *Binah* and *daas* have to work together. Then there is *tevuna*: applying what you understand. After the theory we must ask how it applies and practice that, and the practice builds the ability, just as studying *binah* unlocks *chachma*. Seeing the application affects our emotions and actions too.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 057 ch 10 intro recap.mp3

blocks.outOfPlace: Recap of chapters 1-9 given before chapter 10 is read; it sets out how to study the chain of descent.

blocks.text: The example for all this is *memalei kol almin*, G-d filling all worlds. It is the first topic a person should focus on, because there one can see G-dliness in a very personal way. That unlocks the tangible understanding of *binah* and the personal sense of *daas*, and from there one can go on to *sovev kol almin*, which relates more to *chachma*, and to the idea that everything is like nothing before G-d, which relates more to *Keser*.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 057 ch 10 intro recap.mp3

blocks.outOfPlace: Recap of chapters 1-9 given before chapter 10 is read; it sets out how to study the chain of descent.

blocks.text: Contemplation has two things to balance. One is the detail (*prat*) against the big picture (*klal*). Each has an advantage: the main point is the big picture, but without the details you fool yourself and do not really understand. So begin with a general framework, then focus on the details, always checking how they connect back to the big idea.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 057 ch 10 intro recap.mp3

blocks.outOfPlace: Recap of chapters 1-9 given before chapter 10 is read; it sets out how to study the chain of descent.

blocks.text: The second balance: every contemplation has two parts. One is what we can understand and experience directly and tangibly. The other is beyond our understanding and our experience. We must be aware of both at once: what G-d is creating, and the G-dly force creating it, which is really unknowable.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 057 ch 10 intro recap.mp3

blocks.outOfPlace: Recap of chapters 1-9 given before chapter 10 is read; it sets out how to study the chain of descent.

blocks.text: In chapter 6 the Mitteler Rebbe asks for a balance between the joy of mastery and understanding and the humility and awe of knowing that it is beyond us. Lose the joy and you do not do what you can for your *avoda*. Lose the humility, and you feel only "I can't understand" and still do not work to grasp what is possible. So avoid false humility and ego alike, and keep both feelings.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 057 ch 10 intro recap.mp3

blocks.outOfPlace: Recap of chapters 1-9 given before chapter 10 is read; it sets out how to study the chain of descent.

blocks.text: Do not hold these ideas as a vast encyclopedic store of levels and explanations. The point is to see how all of that knowledge functions as one single unit, and so how G-d's essence is expressed and present down here.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 057 ch 10 intro recap.mp3

blocks.outOfPlace: Recap of chapters 1-9 given before chapter 10 is read; it sets out how to study the chain of descent.

blocks.text: Chapter 7 gave examples of this with *Keser*, and chapter 8 with *chachma* and the *middos*. *Keser* is the *makif*, how G-d's essence transcends everything. Rabbi Walters believes the Rebbe divides it this way for that reason. The unity runs also through the inner levels, *memalei kol almin*, where G-d is revealed in a unique way at each stage, and there too the unity runs from top to bottom.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 057 ch 10 intro recap.mp3

blocks.outOfPlace: Recap of chapters 1-9 given before chapter 10 is read; it sets out how to study the chain of descent.

blocks.text: Chapter 10 introduces a concept, and chapter 11 gives the nimshal, the meaning of the mashalim. The point is this: before the chain of descent, one must see that everything comes from G-d's transcendent essence, and recognize within it what is unknowable and what is knowable. Rambam, *Chovos HaLevavos* and the *Etz Chaim* all begin with this, and the Mitteler Rebbe explains it in the style of *Chassidus*, drawing on those sources.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 058 ch 10 part 1.mp3

blocks.outOfPlace: Introduction to the chapter, given before the reading of line 1.

blocks.text: Now the detail of the four worlds, *Atzilus*, *Beriya*, *Yetzira* and *Asiya*, has to be studied. In each world there are ten *sefiros*, each with its *orot* (lights) and *kelim* (vessels). The task is to understand what each one is, how the lights are clothed in the vessels and how the two relate, in each world and from world to world. Each *sefirah* itself divides into particulars, and those into finer particulars, down to very minute shades of detail and meaning.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 058 ch 10 part 1.mp3

blocks.text: Imagine someone asks what is meant by the kindness within *Malchus*, within *chachma*, within *Malchus*, of *chesed*.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 058 ch 10 part 1.mp3

blocks.text: He points to a switch from Aramaic to Hebrew in this phrase and says he is not sure what the nuance is. Perhaps it concerns two ways the *sefiros* can be included in one another, but it needs further study. The point he presses: the books of *Chassidus* are very precise, and even subtle nuances usually have a lot behind them.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 058 ch 10 part 1.mp3

blocks.text: The example is creation through the ten utterances. G-d's desire to create is *chesed*, and read backwards, *Malchus* is within the *chesed*; it is a palindrome, so the direction hardly matters. G-d's expression of His desire to create is then changed by *chachma* into words that actually create the thing. He thinks the general desire and the general utterances are changed through permutations and *gematriot* into the specific Name that creates each individual thing. He says that perhaps this is the idea.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 058 ch 10 part 1.mp3

blocks.text: The ten *sefiros* are united and joined together in the *Keser* of each world. The *Keser* encompasses them: it is the *makif* that surrounds and pervades them, and all of them are united and encompassed there.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 058 ch 10 part 1.mp3

blocks.text: This holds for each world in particular and for the whole chain of descent in general. The *Keser* is the middle between an upper and a lower world. What comes down from the higher world comes from its *Malchus* into the *Keser*, and the *Keser* holds everything that is then unpacked in the lower world.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 058 ch 10 part 1.mp3

blocks.text: The rule in short: learn to take all the details and see them united, until they become one simple statement that encompasses the whole chain of descent. In that rule the *Malchus* of an upper world becomes the *Keser*, the inner drive and motivating force of the lower world. Follow that chain up through every level, all the way to before the *tzimtzum*.

blocks.text: Before the chain can be studied, anyone entering the study must first study the source of everything. It is the central idea, which is why the *Mishneh Torah* begins with it.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 058 ch 10 part 1.mp3

blocks.text: A person first needs a clear sense of monotheism. When we say "we believe in one G-d," what do we mean? It cannot be words or lip service. That understanding is the foundation of everything else in Judaism: of *Kabbalah*, of *Chassidus*, and even of *halacha*. Everything else is an extension of it, so we begin here.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 058 ch 10 part 1.mp3

blocks.text: Specifically, in *Kabbalah*, we are trying to understand the essence of the Infinite Light before the first *tzimtzum*. The first *tzimtzum* is called the *makom panui*, the empty place, as we mentioned in the previous chapter.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 058 ch 10 part 1.mp3

blocks.text: Even there the particular way, *derech prat*, is needed. As chapter 9 said, at every stage there are two aspects: the unchanging essence before the *tzimtzum*, and the appearance of change and diversity after it. So we first identify the essence above the first *tzimtzum*, the unchanging G-dly essence, and understand it in detail.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 058 ch 10 part 1.mp3

blocks.text: That essence is unknowable, but as chapter 1 taught, *hisbonenus* does not stop at general statements or words. We have to understand it as fully as we can.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 058 ch 10 part 1.mp3

blocks.text: Many Jewish books discuss at length what we mean when we say G-d is one. He has no body and no physical form, and He is not bound by time or space. These fundamental principles of faith we must understand as far as we can, and recognize what is unknowable. A great deal of it can be known, and we are obliged to understand it in detail.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 058 ch 10 part 1.mp3

blocks.text: This pursuit of G-d's simple unity is what is called *ma'arich b'echad*, elongating the word *echad*. It is a concept in *halacha*: when we read the *Shema*, we are supposed to elongate the word *echad*, "Hashem is one."

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 058 ch 10 part 1.mp3

blocks.text: In the plain sense, while we draw out the word *echad* we think about G-d's unity in the heavens, the earth and the four corners of the universe. The *dalet* cannot really be elongated, though some customs pronounce it as a "th" so that it can be drawn out. However it is pronounced, the point is to pause and think about it.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 058 ch 10 part 1.mp3

blocks.text: That is the simple obligation of the *Shema*. In general, the obligation of the *Shema* is not only while reading it: it is to spend time studying and understanding G-d's unity. This is called being *ma'arich b'echad*, delving into G-d's unity, specifically the simple unity before the *tzimtzum*.

blocks.text: In general, the understanding of the simple unity is divided into three stages. From the side of the simple unity there are no stages at all. The division is only three ways we can relate to it and three things we can know about it. Each of these we call a level, and in each of the three levels the ten *sefiros* are included.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 058 ch 10 part 1.mp3

blocks.text: These three terms are found early, in *Chovos HaLevavos* and other early works. *Yachid* means singular or unique, *echad* means one or unified, and *kadmon* means original or eternal.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 058 ch 10 part 1.mp3

blocks.text: *Kadmon* is the word in the debate between Jewish belief and Aristotle on whether the world always existed or was created, and whether time and space are *kadmon*. We say that only G-d is *kadmon*, that He always existed.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 058 ch 10 part 1.mp3

blocks.text: The word also implies an origin. *Kadmon* is a parent and child relation: it is what comes before and is the source of what follows, and it is higher than what comes after it. *Rishon*, by contrast, implies a relation between stages.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 058 ch 10 part 1.mp3

blocks.text: Put simply, the first of the three is that G-d is unique and different from anything in creation. If you imagine anything in the world or in the chain of descent, that is not G-d's essence; He is totally beyond and unique from all His creations. The *Rambam*, *Chovos HaLevavos* and *Kabbalah* all discuss this: G-d is singular and totally alone.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 058 ch 10 part 1.mp3

blocks.text: Then there is the idea that G-d is *echad*, united with all of creation. Everything that exists is an extension and expression of G-d and all one with Him. Looking at all of creation, we see that it is totally dependent on G-d for its existence, so its true reality is not really separate from Him.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 058 ch 10 part 1.mp3

blocks.text: Then there is *kadmon*, which looks at creation as we see it: separate from G-d and distinct from Him. He is the source and origin of everything, the constant foundation that must exist for everything else to exist.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 058 ch 10 part 1.mp3

blocks.text: From this lower perspective, where G-d did create a world that exists, pointing at something in the world and saying that it is G-d would be idolatry. We cannot bring G-d down to that. So there is a distinction, yet everything comes from Him, and that is the idea of *kadmon*. Before getting into *Kabbalah* and *Chassidus*, it helps to think about the plain meaning of these words in the earlier sources.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 058 ch 10 part 1.mp3

blocks.text: All three are within the essence of the infinite light before the first *tzimtzum*: G-d is totally unique and transcends everything; G-d is united with everything; and G-d is the origin of creation as we know it.

phrases.en: from this perspective we can't even say that there's a *Malchus* of the *Ein Sof*

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 058 ch 10 part 1.mp3

phrases.he: ובאמת גם בבחינת העצמות דאור אין סוף שנקרא לבדו כלול בעצמו י׳ ספירות
phrases.en: and yet the truth is, that there's another side to this: even within the essence of the infinite light, which we call alone, He includes the ten *sefiros* within Himself

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 058 ch 10 part 1.mp3

phrases.he: אך שנקרא חכים לא בחכמה ידיעא כידוע,
phrases.en: but this way the *sefiros* are there, it's like it says in the *Zohar* that G-d is wise, but not with a knowable wisdom

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 058 ch 10 part 1.mp3

phrases.he: עד ולאו מכל אלין מדות כלל.
phrases.en: to the point that it says that G-d has nothing to do with these attributes at all

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 058 ch 10 part 1.mp3

blocks.text: So what are these ideas? For now we focus on *yachid*. *Yachid* means G-d is totally alone; the way we say a *ben yachid* means an only child. Compare *echad* in the *seder*, the four children, each one of many: *yachid* means only and singular. So when we say G-d is *yachid*, on one hand He is unique, and from this deeper perspective there is only G-d; nothing else exists.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 058 ch 10 part 1.mp3

blocks.text: *Echad* is higher than the unity of many parts. The idea that G-d unites everything in creation is a lower aspect of *echad*.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 058 ch 10 part 1.mp3

blocks.text: So in the essence itself one cannot yet speak of ten *sefiros*, since ten *sefiros* would be many parts being united, which is *echad*. G-d is completely transcendent, singular and alone.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 058 ch 10 part 1.mp3

blocks.text: The same goes for a *Malchus* of the *Ein Sof*. *Malchus* is speech or expression, and speech implies the desire that motivates it, the wisdom behind it, and automatically the ten *sefiros*. So from the perspective of the essence we cannot say it.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 058 ch 10 part 1.mp3

blocks.text: On this side G-d's essence is completely singular, transcendent and unknowable. In the plain sense we should not think of Him in physical terms, as having a body or as bound by time and space.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 058 ch 10 part 1.mp3

blocks.text: Everything we know and can imagine is created by Him, up to the highest levels: even the ten *sefiros*, even the most subtle philosophical ideas about G-d are constructs He creates, and He transcends them. So we cannot speak of anything relating to the *sefiros* about Him; seemingly He is totally unknowable.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 058 ch 10 part 1.mp3

blocks.text: The other side of it: even within the essence of the infinite light, which we call alone, He includes the ten *sefiros* within Himself.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 058 ch 10 part 1.mp3

blocks.text: The *Zohar* says G-d is wise, but not with a knowable wisdom. All the *sefiros* exist in Him, in a way that is not knowable to us and that we cannot relate to in human terms.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 058 ch 10 part 1.mp3

blocks.text: The text goes so far as to say that G-d has nothing to do with these attributes at all. He is introducing the basic concept here.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 058 ch 10 part 1.mp3

sections.title: The essence is simple light: the Ein Sof's light and the upper purity
sections.summary: The light of the Ein Sof is not separate from its essence. The highest perspective, the upper purity, sees everything as G-d revealing Himself.

phrases.he: והענין הוא דבאמת כמו שעצמות האין סוף
phrases.en: the idea is, that just as the essence of the *Ein Sof*

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 058 ch 10 part 1.mp3

phrases.he: הוא אור פשוט בתכלית הפשיטות,
phrases.en: a completely simple

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 058 ch 10 part 1.mp3

phrases.he: כך ממש בחינת אורו וזיוו הנקרא אור אין סוף דהיינו הוא ושמו בלבד כנזכר לעיל
והוא הנקרא טהירו עילאה
phrases.en: this deeper perspective, this highest perspective, is what is called the upper purity

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 058 ch 10 part 1.mp3

phrases.he: שזהו ענין ובחינת התגלות אור עצמותו כמו שהוא דוקא
phrases.en: the idea of the upper purity is that we're seeing everything, and this is not just before the *tzimtzum*

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 058 ch 10 part 1.mp3

phrases.he: והוא הנקרא יחיד,
phrases.en: and so this deepest perspective is the perspective that we describe as *yachid*

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 058 ch 10 part 1.mp3

phrases.he: שאין עוד מלבדו לומר בו לשון התאחדות או לשון יחוד
phrases.en: from this perspective, there is nothing else to say that G-d is uniting with it

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 058 ch 10 part 1.mp3

phrases.he: וזהו אנת הוא חד ולא בחושבן י' כו'.
phrases.en: and this is the idea that it says in *Pasach Eliyahu*, that G-d is one, but not with a calculation

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 058 ch 10 part 1.mp3

blocks.text: Three stages will be studied one at a time. The first one holds two things together: G-d is unique and transcends everything, and yet that very transcendent essence includes within itself the *sefiros* that appear later in the chain of descent. This is the basic idea to look for at every stage: the unknowable G-dly essence, and the knowable part of that stage that relates to the chain of descent.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 058 ch 10 part 1.mp3

blocks.text: The essence of the *Ein Sof* is a completely simple light, and so its radiance, called the *Or Ein Sof*, is simple too.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 058 ch 10 part 1.mp3

blocks.text: The *Ein Sof* is not G-d's essence. It is the way the essence is described, like a luminary or source: G-d can do whatever He wants and has no limit. That is a completely simple expression of the essence, because it defines Him in no way and limits Him in no way.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 058 ch 10 part 1.mp3

blocks.text: So too the *Or Ein Sof*, the light of the *Ein Sof*, is a revelation: when G-d shows us that He can do anything, and gives an example of one thing He can do.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 058 ch 10 part 1.mp3

blocks.text: From this perspective the whole *Or Ein Sof* is a completely simple light: all of the infinite examples of what G-d can create, all the infinite *sefiros* and worlds He could make, and things that are not even *sefiros*. Creation is seen as an extension of the *Ein Sof* because of choice: G-d is not forced, like a sun that has to shine; He chooses how to create the world.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 058 ch 10 part 1.mp3

blocks.text: So *Hu* is the *Ein Sof*, *shmo* is the *Or Ein Sof*, the light and expression of His infinite ability, and all of it is within the essence, which is called *levad*, alone. This is the sense of "Him and His name alone."

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 058 ch 10 part 1.mp3

blocks.text: This deeper perspective, the highest, is the *tehiru ila'a*, the upper purity. It is where we close our eyes when we say *Shema*, and try to picture a place where there is only G-d, and everything that exists is an unlimited expression of His choosing to show different things He can do.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 058 ch 10 part 1.mp3

blocks.text: The idea of the upper purity is that we see everything, not only before the *tzimtzum*. From this perspective everything, even after the *tzimtzum*, is really like this; we just do not see it that way. If we could see everything around us as G-d choosing what He wants, we would see each thing as a revelation of His essence, not only as the limited form it has.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 058 ch 10 part 1.mp3

blocks.text: So this deepest perspective is the one we call *yachid*, and from it we can have an idea of ten *sefiros*: G-d is totally unlimited, and because He can do whatever He wants He can also create ten *sefiros*. It is not like our own ten traits, which we are born with and are stuck within. Here all of it comes by choice. That is why it is called an unknowable *chachma*, coming from this unlimited ability.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 058 ch 10 part 1.mp3

blocks.text: From this perspective there is nothing else to say that G-d is uniting with the *sefiros*. *Chachma* is G-d being G-d and choosing what He wants; *binah* is G-d simply being Himself. The differences do not really exist in a meaningful way, because they are all His essence, and so we cannot describe them as uniting, or as two things fusing and joining.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 058 ch 10 part 1.mp3

blocks.text: This is the idea in *Pasach Eliyahu*, from the *Tikkunei Zohar*: G-d is one, but not with a calculation.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 058 ch 10 part 1.mp3

blocks.text: The Arizal explains what kind of calculation is meant: G-d is not one made of the ten *sefiros*, nor one of them, nor the *Keser*, nor a higher eleventh *sefirah*. He transcends the whole idea of the *sefiros*, a simple essence that can do whatever He wants. That is beyond our understanding, yet it plugs into what we know: all the *sefiros* come from this higher source.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 058 ch 10 part 1.mp3

phrases.he: אך מה שאמרו חכים ולא בחכמה ידיעא
phrases.en: so this that we say that G-d is wise, but not with a knowable wisdom

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 058 ch 10 part 1.mp3

phrases.he: כו'
phrases.en: there are meaningful definitions and distinctions between G-d being wise and G-d being understanding and G-d being kind and G-d being merciful

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 058 ch 10 part 1.mp3

phrases.he: שיש על כל פנים חלוקי מדריגות, חכים ומבין חסדן ורחמן כו' הכל לא מצד עצמותו,
phrases.en: all of those distinctions are not distinctions that exist from the perspective of His essence

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 058 ch 10 part 1.mp3

phrases.he: רק מצד מה ששיער בעצמו בכח מה שעתיד להיות בפועל אחר הצמצום הראשון הנזכר לעיל
phrases.en: it's only from the perspective that since G-d created the world, He must have chosen in His essence to invent the idea of *chachma* and *binah* and *chesed* and *rachamim*

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 058 ch 10 part 1.mp3

phrases.he: (וכמו שכתוב במקדש מלך בלשון האריז''ל עצמו ומבואר במקום אחר באריכות)
phrases.en: like it's explained in the *Mikdash Melech*, in the book quoting the Arizal, and like it's explained elsewhere at length in the works of *Chassidus*

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 058 ch 10 part 1.mp3

blocks.text: We say that G-d is wise, but not with a knowable wisdom. Until now this section has looked at the transcendent side: the unknowable essence that goes beyond any definition.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 058 ch 10 part 1.mp3

blocks.text: The other side: even at the level of *yachid* we say that G-d has *chachma* and *binah*, but not in a knowable way. Still, saying that He is wise, understanding, kind and merciful seems to imply real and meaningful distinctions between these.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 058 ch 10 part 1.mp3

blocks.text: Those distinctions do not exist from the perspective of His essence. They are only from the perspective of what He arranged in Himself, of what was to come into actuality after the first *tzimtzum*. Since He created a world with these attributes, they must come from Him. Looking back, we see them as separate after the *tzimtzum*, but from the essence where they come from there is no distinction. For Him there is no difference between creating *chachma*, *binah*, *chesed* or *gevura*. The *Mikdash Melech* explains this at length, quoting the Arizal, and the works of *Chassidus* do too.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 058 ch 10 part 1.mp3

phrases.he: וזהו ענין כללות המאמר הראשון
phrases.en: and this is the meaning of the first teaching in the *Zohar*

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 058 ch 10 part 1.mp3

phrases.he: בזוהר, בריש הורמנא דמלכא גליף גליפו בטהירו עילאה
phrases.en: in the beginning of the desire of the King, He engraved an engraving, in upper purity

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 058 ch 10 part 1.mp3

phrases.he: פירוש בעצמות גלוי אורו הפשוט הנזכר לעיל
phrases.en: meaning that within this essential, simple light of G-d's essence

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 058 ch 10 part 1.mp3

phrases.he: שנקרא טהירו עילאה, גליף גליפו שהוא ענין חקיקת אותיות
phrases.en: so in that level, He engraved an engraving, which is the idea of forming letters, and a letter is a limited revelation that has a certain form

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 058 ch 10 part 1.mp3

phrases.he: ובריש הורמנא, שזה כשעלה ברצונו הפשוט, הוא בחינת כתר, ובחינת האותיות שחקק הוא בחינת המלכות דאור אין סוף
phrases.en: that's when it arose in His simple will; that's the *Keser* of the *Ein Sof*, and the letters that He engraved, where He chose a form in which to reveal Himself, is the idea of the *Malchus* of the *Or Ein Sof*

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 058 ch 10 part 1.mp3

phrases.he: ואם כן יש ראש וסוף, כתר ומלכות, גם בבחינת עצמיות אור אין סוף
phrases.en: and so we see that there's this idea of a beginning and an end, a *Keser* and a *Malchus*, even within the essence, even in the essence of the infinite light

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 058 ch 10 part 1.mp3

blocks.text: This is the meaning of the Zohar's first teaching. In the original printings it was the first page of the Zohar; in our editions it starts on page 15, after a fourteen-page introduction. Either way it opens *Bereishis* and explains what "in the beginning" means.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 058 ch 10 part 1.mp3

blocks.text: The Zohar's words are: in the beginning of the desire of the King, He engraved an engraving in the upper purity (*tehiru ila'a*). The Rebbe's text has *horemana*, and the versions differ slightly.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 058 ch 10 part 1.mp3

blocks.text: G-d first engraved a dark point, a hidden spark, brought out from the most concealed place of the *Ein Sof*. From that He emanated a line of light into the sphere, which was shapeless and had no color at all: not white, not black, not green. From there He emanated all the colors. This is the beginning of creation, and it became the source of everything.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 058 ch 10 part 1.mp3

blocks.text: So the idea is: at the beginning of the King's will He engraved an engraving in the upper purity. Within this essential, simple light of G-d's essence, that is the upper purity.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 058 ch 10 part 1.mp3

blocks.text: G-d has within Himself the idea of His self-expression, that He can do anything and can show it. At that level, to engrave is the idea of forming letters, and a letter is a limited revelation with a definite form.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 058 ch 10 part 1.mp3

blocks.text: When His desire arose in His simple will, that is the *Keser* of the *Ein Sof*. The letters He engraved, the form in which He chose to reveal Himself, are the *Malchus* of the *Or Ein Sof*. The Zohar already alludes to this: in the simple unity, G-d revealed the idea of a *Keser*, and then all the way down to *Malchus*.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 058 ch 10 part 1.mp3

blocks.text: So there is a beginning and an end, a *Keser* and a *Malchus*, even within the essence of the infinite light. We have to understand both: the transcendent nature of G-d's essence, and how that essence can include within itself the source of diverse expressions and yet remain transcendent and the same.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 058 ch 10 part 1.mp3

blocks.text: From the perspective of that essence nothing is changing, though it is expressed in many ways. We will see how it is expressed in the ten *sefiros*, because those are what we relate to, as people built with these ten attributes.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 058 ch 10 part 1.mp3

sections.title: The will for kindness in the soul's raw potential
sections.summary: A kind person's desire for kindness is an essence that holds in raw form all the details it will later show, and the faculties of the soul are included in it before they come out.

phrases.he: והדמיון בזה ידוע מכחות הנפש בהתגלות מרצון עד המעשה
phrases.en: the metaphor, the comparison that we make to this is known, from the human soul, when our different faculties are revealed, we have ten faculties starting from *ratzon*, and then *chachma*, *binah*, and all the corresponding faculties all the way down to the faculty of action

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 059 ch 10 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: שישנם כולם בפרט בהעלם אור עצמות הנפש שנקרא בחינת יחידה
phrases.en: all of these exist first in a hidden way within the light of the essence of the soul, which is called *yechida*

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 059 ch 10 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: כמו על דרך דוגמא כאשר האדם הוא חפץ חסד וטוב להטיב בדבר פרט,
phrases.en: for example, when a person is a kind person and desires to actually help somebody in a particular way

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 059 ch 10 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: שזהו בא מצד שיש בו מדה זאת דחפץ חסד וטוב בבחינת עצמות נפשו, הנקרא יחידה
phrases.en: what is the source of that motivation, it's because within the essence of the human soul, one of the characteristics that G-d endowed with us is this essential nature of kindness and empathy and a desire to help other people

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 059 ch 10 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: על כן בא חפץ חסד זה בגלוי מן העלמו
phrases.en: and so therefore this essential desire of kindness is now being revealed and being expressed when the person comes to a situation where that's necessary

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 059 ch 10 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: ומוכרח לומר בוודאי שחפץ חסד זה בעצמות נפשו הוא בבחינת כח היולי בעצמיות
phrases.en: and we must say, certainly, that this essential desire of kindness, the way it is in the essence of the soul, is what is described as a *hiyuli* power

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 059 ch 10 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: לכלול כל מה שעתיד לחפוץ בחסד וטוב
phrases.en: it includes within itself the potential, the ability to generate whatever a person is ever destined to desire in terms of kindness and goodness

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 059 ch 10 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: בכל פרטי פרטי הענינים שיבקשו ממנו
phrases.en: with all the minute details of whatever will be required of him, he's going to be able to generate the desire to do those things

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 059 ch 10 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: ואם כן בהכרח שקודם שעלה ברצונו וחפצו זה שבגלוי, להטיב חסדו בדבר זה הפרטי,
phrases.en: so before, the guests came to Avraham or anything like that, where there was no particular manifestation, it's just an innate quality within the soul, so before those details came up

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 059 ch 10 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: היה כלול בעצמיות חפץ חסד ההיולי
phrases.en: so the possibility of that happening was just included within their essential desire for kindness, this *hiyuli* desire for kindness

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 059 ch 10 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: ויצא מן ההיולי להתגלות בדבר פרטי זה
phrases.en: and then, when the situation arose, this essential desire for kindness, which is totally abstract and doesn't relate to any particular detail, now in the situation it got plugged into that situation and it became manifest in this particular way of giving the people food

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 059 ch 10 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: The comparison is the human soul and its faculties. Ten faculties come out in revelation, from *ratzon* (will), through *chachma*, *binah* and their corresponding faculties, down to the faculty of action.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 059 ch 10 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: All of these faculties exist first, in a hidden way, within the light of the essence of the soul, which is called *yechida*. This relation of a simple essence to what comes after it is the *mashal* used to understand G-d's simple essence and how it relates to the ten *sefiros*.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 059 ch 10 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: The *Alter Rebbe* says in many places that the essence of our soul is something even we do not know. We feel alive and feel that we have a soul, but its essence transcends our understanding and any particular form we could describe, and yet it is expressed in all sorts of ways. That is the basic idea of the *mashal*.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 059 ch 10 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: A kind person desires to help someone in a particular way. *Chesed* is the feeling of kindness within a person, and *tov* is the doing of good that benefits someone else. Where does the motivation come from? Because within the essence of the soul there is a trait that G-d gave us: the essential nature of kindness and empathy, the wish to help and contribute.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 059 ch 10 part 2.mp3

blocks.title: The kind person

blocks.text: So this essential desire is revealed when a situation calls for it. Sitting at home, the person had no particular wish to help this person. The point is the relation of an essence to its revelation.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 059 ch 10 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: An essence is by nature transcendent. In the *Kuntres* on the nature of *Chassidus*, the *yechida* is compared to oil, which has three features: it is the essence, so it is found in everything, from people to animals to plants to inanimate things; it is like the distilled, concentrated energy that is stored up in fat; and it floats on top of everything and permeates everything.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 059 ch 10 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: So an essence is the essence of everything. It transcends any particular form or detail, and yet it is found within all of them. The desire for kindness is the same.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 059 ch 10 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: The essential desire to help does not relate to any particular detail. A person sitting at home is not thinking of the old lady across the street or of a particular charity; those are circumstantial. In any situation, based on the person's evaluation of it, if someone needs coats, shoes or food, a kind person is moved to help in that particular way. So the essential desire stays abstract and beyond the details, and yet it gives rise to all of them according to the situation in the world.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 059 ch 10 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: The abstract essence does not know or care about the details of the world. But when a person looks around, the sparks in what he sees arouse the desire, as we discussed in Reb Hillel's *Biur*. *Avraham* sat at the door of his tent looking for an opportunity to do kindness. When the three guests came, the desire woke and showed itself in a particular way: water to wash their feet, shade under a tree, food and drink. That is the basic idea of this *mashal*.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 059 ch 10 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: So certainly this essential desire of kindness, in the essence of the soul, is what is described as a *hiyuli* power. *Hiyuli* is rendered in Yiddish as essence; the word may be Greek, and it means something completely essential that has no defined form.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 059 ch 10 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: It includes within itself the ability to generate whatever kindness a person is ever destined to desire, with all the minute details of what will be asked of him.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 059 ch 10 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: So before the guests came to *Avraham*, before any particular manifestation of this desire, it was only an innate quality of the soul. Before those details came up, the possibility of them was included within the essential desire for kindness, this *hiyuli* desire.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 059 ch 10 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: Then the essential desire came out of the *hiyuli* into this particular situation. The abstract desire got plugged into that situation and became manifest in the particular way that the situation needed: giving the people food, or whatever else.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 059 ch 10 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: A kind person always finds a way to help, whether it is a child or an adult, and in many different ways. We see the same with a *Rebbe*: sometimes it is a referral to a doctor, sometimes a blessing, sometimes something spiritual and sometimes something physical. Whatever helps the person comes out according to the needs of that individual, the time and the situation.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 059 ch 10 part 2.mp3

blocks.title: The kind person

phrases.he: ואנו רואים שיש בחפץ חסד זה שכל וחכמה ומדות ומחשבה ודבור ומעשה
phrases.en: when this desire for kindness is manifest, in order to effectively help somebody you need *sechel*, intellect; you have to understand the situation and what they really need, and do it with wisdom, and there are emotions involved

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 059 ch 10 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: אם כן ודאי במקור חפץ חסד זה בהעלמו, כשהיה כלול בעצמיות החפץ חסד ההיולי,
גם כן מהתחלקות שכל ומדות ומחשבה דבור ומעשה שבו
phrases.en: so this essential source, we can say, also was the source of all these different divisions of the intellect and the emotions and the thoughts, speech, and action that came out with this kindness

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 059 ch 10 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: אבל בבחינת עצמיות חפץ חסד ההיולי, כמו שהוא קודם שבא עדיין בדבר פרטי,
הגם שבודאי גם שם יש התחלקות שכל ומדות כו',
phrases.en: even there, we must say that it had the possibility to generate all these different details of the intellect and emotions, etc.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 059 ch 10 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: מכל מקום כלולים ומתאחדים בתכלית
phrases.en: but at that point, when we're looking at it from that perspective, they're all really one

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 059 ch 10 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: When this desire is manifest and really helps, you need *sechel*: you have to understand the situation and what the person really needs, and you have to do it with wisdom. Emotions come in too, about what is good for them and what is bad for them.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 059 ch 10 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: A sick person needs what helps and must be kept from what harms; the same thing can save one person and endanger another, so the feelings about what a thing does depend on the person and the situation.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 059 ch 10 part 2.mp3

sensitivity.reason: Medical examples (which medicines and foods help or harm a sick person) that a reader could act on.
sensitivity.publishable: A sick person needs what helps and must be kept from what harms. The same care can be right for one person and wrong for another, so one must judge each person and each situation.

blocks.text: A person who is really poor and needs a loan: kindness wants to give money. A spoiled person who wants money only to squander it: kindness refuses to enable that, and tries to get him to learn to work and be responsible.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 059 ch 10 part 2.mp3

blocks.title: The loan and the spendthrift

blocks.text: The same actions are met by *chesed* and by *gevura* in different ways, and that takes understanding. The understanding generates the *middos*, and they generate thought, speech and action. Even the same desire of kindness can come out as a harsh speech, like a parent disciplining a child: it comes from love, and it teaches good manners, good *middos*, tolerance and flexibility.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 059 ch 10 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: So on one side, this desire within the essence is a simple, abstract thing. It does not relate to any of these details, contains no knowledge or thought of the outside world, and has to do only with yourself. This is the main distinction for the levels before the *seder hishtalshelus*, before the *tzimtzum*, and even until *Atzilus*. The *mashal* for it is how things are inside a person: he has a nature, desires and preferences, which are internal, more essential and more abstract, and then there is how they plug into the outside world, which is more concrete.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 059 ch 10 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: So the two come from looking in and from looking out, and they are very different in nature. That is the basic idea we are looking at.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 059 ch 10 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: Because G-d gave us a human soul, the internal desire for kindness is an essential quality of empathy and the need to help people. But that essential desire has no direct connection to anything in the world. It is totally abstract, and yet it can motivate all kinds of particular desires and ways of thinking, feeling and acting, based on our evaluation of the situation and how we plug it in.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 059 ch 10 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: So again there are two sides: the essential, abstract side, which we cannot describe or define in worldly terms, which is how the kindness was when it was hidden within the essential *hiyuli* desire of kindness. At that point there are no divisions of *sechel* or *middos*.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 059 ch 10 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: Yet since we see that it actually motivated particular desires, with particular ways of thinking, we can say that those came from there and attribute them to their source. So the essential source was also the source of the different divisions of intellect, emotion, thought, speech and action that came out with this kindness.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 059 ch 10 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: We can think of this desire in two ways. The first is how it got plugged into a particular desire, where we can attribute the different aspects to it and say it was their source. The second is the essential desire before it got plugged into any particular desire. Nothing changes in the essence; only the way we think about it and speak of it is different.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 059 ch 10 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: Thought of in terms of how it is essentially, before it got plugged into this situation, it could in theory have never happened, and then the situation would never have arisen.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 059 ch 10 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: So even there, before it came into a particular matter, it had the possibility to generate all these different details of intellect and emotion. Yet they are all united completely there, when we look at it from that perspective. There is only the essential power of kindness, and so we cannot speak of any division within it.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 059 ch 10 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: This is the basic metaphor. The essential desire of kindness gets plugged into details out in the world, and we can look at it from after it was plugged in or from before. From one side we speak of it as relating to the details that came after; from the other side, it transcends them, and all those specifics are the same thing. From that point of view you simply want to do what is kind; it does not matter which way. Two mature adults discussing how to accomplish something may both want the same general thing and have many strategies, and in the end it is irrelevant which way they do it. They can agree to go either way.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 059 ch 10 part 2.mp3

blocks.title: Two ways to the same goal

phrases.he: וכמו כן במדה פרטית אחרת שבעצמיות, כמו מדת הגבורה והתפארת והנצח וכהאי גוונא
phrases.en: and the same general relationship applies to any of the other particular attributes the way they are in the essence, like the attribute of *gevura*, *tiferes* and *netzach*

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 059 ch 10 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: עד בחינת המלכות
phrases.en: and this is true even of *Malchus*

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 059 ch 10 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: שהוא מדת ההתנשאות
שכלול בודאי מי', רצון וחפץ למלוכה וחכמה ומדות ומחשבה כו'.

blocks.text: The same general relationship applies to every other attribute as it is in the essence: *gevura*, *tiferes*, *netzach* and so on.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 059 ch 10 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: Take the essential attribute of *gevura*, justice: we want things to be just. G-d gives us that, so it makes us want rules and to punish the wicked, and it can motivate all sorts of things. The same is true of *tiferes*, the essential seeking of beauty, wanting to beautify things and to praise and show off what we appreciate. It can be expressed well or badly: it can be a person showing off in a bad way, or wanting to beautify things like the Torah.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 059 ch 10 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: It is all coming from the same essential desire, and the question is what it gets plugged into: something good or something bad. That is a separate matter, which we will take up later.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 059 ch 10 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: And *netzach*, the same: the desire to overcome challenges and win. A person who likes challenges loves puzzles and games and competition, whether in fun or in a serious struggle to overcome an opponent in battle. G-d gives us that desire to dominate and win, and it can be expressed in millions of ways: a person might become very into chess, or wrestling, or war, or just in his personal struggle to overcome the *yetzer hara*.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 059 ch 10 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: The essence of each attribute transcends the details, but when it is plugged in, it becomes the source of, and the motivation for, all those details. So too with the other attributes.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 059 ch 10 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: Even *Malchus*, which is the attribute of *hisnasus*. One might think *Malchus* relates only to others, to being a king over people, but it has the same relation: the essential desire to rule and the will and desire to reign, with *chachma* and *middos* and *machshava* as well.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 059 ch 10 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: אך קודם שבא לבחינת התגלות בדבר פרט, כמו למלוך על מדינה זו וכהאי גוונא,
phrases.en: before it came and was plugged into a particular thing, like being king over a particular nation

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 059 ch 10 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: כלולים ומתאחדים בתכלית בבחינת מדת המלוכה ההיולית העצמית
phrases.en: all of the details of what it means to be a leader and a king were just included in this essential nature within the soul

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 059 ch 10 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: כמו בעצמות חפץ חסד ההיולי הנ"ל
phrases.en: just the same way with the essential desire for kindness

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 059 ch 10 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: The attribute of *Malchus* appears in a child who dominates animals, an immature expression of it. The deeper leadership comes out when people need someone to lead and accept him, and it may lie dormant until then. Being a parent brings it out: you must lead at home and feel responsible for others. It generates desires, thoughts and emotions natural to it.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 059 ch 10 part 2.mp3

blocks.title: The child and the animals

blocks.text: Before this attribute of kingship was plugged into a particular thing, like being king over a nation, it did not relate to any place. Take baby Napoleon, before he knew what country he was in: his leadership was not tied to any country. All the details of leadership were included in the essential nature of the soul, without policies yet.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 059 ch 10 part 2.mp3

blocks.title: Baby Napoleon

blocks.text: Just the same way with the essential desire for kindness: all the details of kindness did not yet exist there, and they come out based on the situation.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 059 ch 10 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: וא"כ מובן ממילא שבחינת מדת העצמיות דכח''ב וחג''ת ונהי''ם ההיולים שבעצמיות הנפש,
phrases.en: so too the essence of the soul includes all these ten attributes, and all these ten attributes are really just different ways that this one essence of the soul is expressed

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 059 ch 10 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: לא יתכן לומר גם לשון זה שמתאחדים וכלולים בעצמיות הנפש הנקרא יחידה
phrases.en: you can't describe these essential attributes as being something separate from the essence, from the *yechida*, that is then united with them

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 059 ch 10 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: מאחר שאינן נבדלים מן העצם כלל
phrases.en: because really in the essence, the essential idea of being kind is not something you learn, it's that you are kind

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 059 ch 10 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: If so, it is understood that the essence of the soul includes all these ten attributes, and that they are different ways the one essence is expressed. So you cannot describe these essential attributes as something separate from the essence, from the *yechida*, that then unites with them. The relation of the *yechida* to the faculties is not a source that unites and includes them; it is a completely higher essence that automatically gives rise to all of them, as the *Kuntres* explains.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 059 ch 10 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: So the *yechida* gives us this essence, with the ability to make choices and express ourselves in an essential and unlimited way.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 059 ch 10 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: Our *mashal* is a little different from the *nimshal*, because the human soul is imprinted with a certain form, as we discussed in Reb Hillel's *Biur*. It is a process that starts out completely simple, and then the spark becomes somewhat defined.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 059 ch 10 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: Even at this stage, when it is somewhat defined, there is no real difference in the essence between *chesed*, *gevura*, *malchus* and the others. The essence can choose to express itself and be itself, with an unlimited freedom to choose, and it comes out in all these different ways. We cannot speak of them as separate things attached to the soul; it is really the soul itself. The differences we talk about arise only when the soul expresses itself in the world. From the point of view of the essence it is one power, turning on all these different attributes.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 059 ch 10 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: So we cannot speak of them as separate from the essence, because in the essence the idea of being kind is not something you learn and are taught. Being human means you have kindness and empathy as an essential part of what it means to be you.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 059 ch 10 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: הגם שהוא חלק אחד הנמשך מעצם הנפש ממש, שלמעלה מהיות חפץ חסד בעצמיות, שזהו ענין פרטי ממהותה העצמית הפשוטה בתכלית
phrases.en: that this is just a certain aspect of the simple, transcendent essence of the soul

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 059 ch 10 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: Kindness is one particular aspect that comes from the essence of the soul itself, a part of its very nature. That aspect belongs to the simple, transcendent essence of the soul, which is completely simple.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 059 ch 10 part 2.mp3

blocks.outOfPlace: Line 51 is read here (059 w4636) though its alignment mark is missing; line 50 is not read.

phrases.he: מכל מקום אי אפשר לומר בו שמתאחד במדת נצוח ההיולית הנטוע בעצם הנפש,
phrases.en: even though you can describe it in one way as one aspect of the self, you can't describe them as separate things that unite with each other

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 059 ch 10 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: מאחר שמיוחדים שניהם בעצמות ואינן נבדלים כלל וכלל מן העצם
phrases.en: because they're both completely unified with the essence, and they're not at all separate or distinct from the essence

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 059 ch 10 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: You can say that kindness is one aspect of the self and that *netzach* is another, but you cannot describe them as separate things that unite with each other in the *hiyuli* attribute implanted in the essence of the soul.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 059 ch 10 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: Kindness cannot unite with the essential *netzach*, because both are completely unified with the essence and are not separate or distinct from it. The *mashal* of the *yechida* is hard to grasp here, because kindness, *gevura* and *netzach* are all the same to the essence. So a second *mashal* will show that all of these attributes are one and the same to the essence.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 059 ch 10 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: Here is a recap. The *mashal* for the relation of the essence of the infinite light to the ten *sefiros* is our *yechida*: G-d gives the essence of our soul as a simple ability of free choice, imprinted as part of the nature of a human soul, so that we have curiosity, empathy, and overcoming challenges.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 059 ch 10 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: All of those are really the same essence, expressed differently when it is plugged into the world. The ways we divide it up are artificial. From the essence's point of view it is one point. The same quality of being human looks like curiosity when plugged into one thing, like kindness when plugged into another, and like the drive to overcome challenges when plugged into a third. It is the one essential human quality, given to us in our soul, expressed in different forms.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 059 ch 10 part 2.mp3

sections.title: Motion and consciousness: one essence in its expressions
sections.summary: The power of movement and the power of consciousness show that the essence contains its expressions and is not separate from them, and that the differences come from the vessels.

phrases.he: על דרך דוגמא כח התנועה שנכלל ממש בעצם החי
phrases.en: for example, the power of movement, which is included in the essence of a living being and is completely one with it

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

phrases.he: קודם שמניעו לגמרי, שאינו נבדל מן העצם כלל
אף על פי שבגלוי כח התנועה להניע דבר פרט, יתחלק לכמה פרטי אופנים,
phrases.en: so even though when you actually express that power and move, it's going to be divided into many particular motions

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

phrases.he: אי אפשר לומר שכל אופני פרטי התנועה כלולים ומתאחדים היו, כשהיה כח התנועה נכלל בעצם החי
phrases.en: we can't describe the power of movement as having all of these individual movements as separate things that were united in it

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

phrases.he: מאחר שאז לא היה בסוג וגדר תנועה כלל,
phrases.en: because at that point the entire concept of movement doesn't exist

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

phrases.he: לא בכלל ולא בפרט כו'

blocks.text: Continuing the essence and how it relates to what comes from it. The mashal of the *yechida* shows it in ourselves, and the same is true of everything: each thing has an inner essence. Now the mashalim show the two sides of an essence: it transcends everything, so all its expressions are the same to it, and it permeates each thing.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

blocks.text: Take the power of movement, which is included in the essence of a living being and is one with it. A person or an animal that is alive can move. The essence of that power is only the choice to turn the muscles on and off. Whether the signal goes to an arm or a leg makes no real difference to the power itself; the particular movements come from how the bones and muscles are put together. The essential power is the choice to send a signal down the nerves.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

blocks.title: The power of movement

blocks.text: Even someone who loses a limb can learn to send the signal from higher nerves to a prosthetic arm.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

blocks.text: So the essential power of movement, before it moves at all, is not separate from the essence. It is only the ability to choose to move or not. The essence is like electricity: the same power from the wall can run a toaster, a radio or a computer, and what the raw force comes out as is entirely a product of the vessels (*kelim*) that use it.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

blocks.text: When the power is expressed it divides into many particular motions, because many muscles connected in different ways move the legs, the arms, the body. Still, we cannot say that all those particular motions were united as separate things within the power of movement, when it was included in the essence of the living being.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

blocks.text: The power is the same simple ability to turn something on or off, and what is turned on or off does not matter at that point. It is like a computer that controls a light, or a motor, or anything else: the same essential ability is channeled into many functions, and within the essential ability there is no difference between them.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

blocks.text: At that point the whole concept of movement does not exist yet; the power transcends the realm of movement. It is not in the general and not in the particular: it does not have the details of each motion, and even the idea of motion is not relevant there.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

blocks.text: The concept of physical motion is based on our physical universe and the way the body is built. The soul's power to choose has nothing really to do with that. It is the ability to choose "I want this" or "I don't," and that is what we meant by the spiritual idea of movement: change and self-expression in different ways, as we discussed in Reb Hillel's *Biur*.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

blocks.text: In this first *mashal* we see that to the essence all the different expressions are equal, one essential power, and the form comes entirely from the vessels through which it is expressed. Our power of kindness, or of *gevura*, is the same kind of thing: a simple essence that is plugged into the situation. All the ways it is expressed come from being plugged in there, but to the essence they are all the same.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

blocks.text: Deeper still: our humanity, that we have a G-dly soul, gives us the essential ability to be curious (*chachma*), kind (*chesed*), and to have a sense of justice (*gevura*). G-d gave us this *tzelem Elokim*, this G-dly image, and plugging that essence in gives what it means to be G-dly and human in these different areas. It looks like many different things, but it is the same essential *yechida* plugged in.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

phrases.he: וכן בחינת גילוי התפשטות החיות להחיות כל הגוף
phrases.en: and a similar thing with the extension of *chayos*

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

phrases.he: בעודנו כלול לגמרי בעצם רוח החיים
phrases.en: when it is still just included within our essential, our soul's consciousness before it connects to the body

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

phrases.he: הגם שבגלויו מתחלק לראיה ושמיעה לעין ואוזן וכהאי גוונא
phrases.en: when this power comes into the eye and comes into the ear, it gets divided into the ability to see, to hear, and to feel, cold and hot, and all these different senses

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

phrases.he: שבודאי גם טרם בואו להתגשם בעין ואוזן בפועל,
היה כלול בו חיות הראיה הרוחנית לעין בפני עצמו,
phrases.en: before your consciousness became lowered and associated with the physical sensations of your eye or your ear, it already had within itself the experience of these colors and flavors and sounds; they must have existed within the soul, because the outside world is just calling them up

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

phrases.he: וחיות השמיעה באוזן בפני עצמו מכל מקום קודם שבאה עצם הנפש לכלל בחינת התפשטות החיות, גם שכלול בה, הרי זה כהתכללות כח התנועה בעצם החי הנזכר לעיל
phrases.en: but before the essence of the soul extends its consciousness into the body, even though within itself it already has the potential to generate these diverse experiences, this is like the inclusion of the power of movement in the essence of the living being

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

blocks.text: *Chayos* is usually translated as lifeforce or vitality, but in most contexts, and here, it means consciousness: the extension of consciousness to bring awareness to the whole body. Look carefully at the context for the exact shade of meaning of these words.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

blocks.text: This consciousness is still included wholly in the essence of the soul, before it connects to the body. When it comes into the eye and the ear it is divided into the ability to see, hear, feel hot and cold, and the other senses, but it remains one simple power of awareness.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

blocks.text: The colors you see and the sounds you hear do not really exist outside you. Light of a certain wavelength hits the eye and triggers a cell, and the experience of red exists only within you. The soul has the infinite ability to experience, and the outside stimulus calls forth what is already in it.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

blocks.title: Red inside you

blocks.text: So our soul and body filter out other experiences and bring forward the part of us that matches the stimulus. Seeing or tasting, you experience a little of yourself and associate it with something outside. This is what is called psychophysical: the physical wavelengths, and their experience within.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

blocks.text: That is why it is impossible to know whether my red is the same as your red, or my sound the same as your sound. We know that there are physical differences, but as to the sensation itself, you can think about it.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

blocks.text: It is possible that what I call red is what you call blue, and there would be no way to prove that or share it, because those experiences are internal to each person, and nothing internal and essential to yourself can be fully shared with someone outside you.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

blocks.text: This is the main thing to highlight: there are two worlds. One is our internal world, essential and unique, which we cannot really share. The other is the outside world, and we can associate something internal with something external. That association has a limitation: the essence does not completely come across.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

blocks.text: So on one side the same essence can be plugged into things in many ways, as different languages can say the same thing in many ways. On the other side, the internal experience that is triggered is real, part of you, and essential. The power of consciousness is the same, filtered through the eye, the ear, the nose and the tongue to give different sensations, but those sensations are really part of your essence. This is how the essence permeates everything.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

blocks.text: Before your consciousness was lowered and associated with the physical sensations of eye or ear, it already had inside itself the experiences of these colors, flavors and sounds. They could not be created by the outside world, which only calls them up, so they must fully exist within the essence. So there must already have been a unique experience of sight and of sound.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

blocks.text: Before the essence of the soul extends its consciousness into the body, it has the potential to generate these diverse experiences. This is like the power of movement included in the essence of the living being. With movement it is clear that the differences come from the vessels; here the differences are in the light itself, in the internal experience.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

blocks.text: The soul can be a shape-changer: it makes itself into any form or any kind of experience. But the fact that it can shift its own inner state into all these flavors and sounds is one simple power that has no definition or form in itself. Imagine a creature that can take any shape it wants. That is one simple essential ability, containing no details within itself; taking this shape or that is an external expression of it.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

blocks.title: The shape-changer

phrases.he: וכל מה שמוכן ועתיד לבוא לידי גלוי בפועל החיות
עדיין, יתכן היחוד וההתכללות דראיה ושמיעה וכהאי גוונא
phrases.en: as long as you're speaking about the actual sights and sounds that came out, and when we look back and say these were ready to come out, they had that potential, then you can look at them as separate things

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

phrases.he: אבל כאשר כלול לגמרי בעצם הנפש והיה כלא יש במציאות התפשטות חיות כלל
phrases.en: but when you're going back a step, to the way they are from the essence's point of view, where it has this essential ability and this free choice of how to create those experiences, at that point the whole concept of the expression and actual manifestation of this ability doesn't exist yet

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

phrases.he: וכלל מצד עצם הנפש שלמעלה הרבה מבחינת התפשטות,
phrases.en: from the perspective of the essence of the soul, which completely transcends this idea of these expressions and extensions

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

phrases.he: רק שכולל בעצמות גם כן בחינת ההתפשטות, כעצם החי שכולל בעצמו כח התנועה כנזכר לעיל
phrases.en: this is like the essence of a living thing, the essence of life that includes within itself the ability to move the body in different ways

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

phrases.he: אם כן איך יתכן בחינת היחוד והתכללות דפרטי אור וחיות
phrases.en: so when can we speak of a unification of many different distinct powers and types of experience, and being included within one source

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

phrases.he: רק מצד שעתיד ומוכן לצאת בהתפשטות חיות
phrases.en: when we're speaking from the point of view of what is going to come out, since we know what comes out, we could say these were already there in potential

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

phrases.he: בהתחלקות פרטי חיות מזה מוכרח לומר שיש כל פרטים הללו בהתפשטות הכלולה בעצם לגמרי,
phrases.en: we must say that all these details that we see in the expression, in the manifestation, must have already existed within the essence, and therefore we could speak of them as there, but united

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

phrases.he: שאם לא כן מאין נמצאו פרטים הללו בגלוי ההתפשטות
phrases.en: if they weren't there in the essence, where would these details come from? Obviously, the only source creating them is the essence

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

phrases.he: כמו האור וזיו שכלול בעצם השמש,
phrases.en: this is the metaphor of the sun and the light of the sun

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

phrases.he: שיש בו בהעלם כל פרטי אופני זיו המתפשט וכהאי גוונא ודי למבין.
phrases.en: the sun is the luminary; then there is the general white light, and then all the particular rays of light, which need to be filtered out through differently colored glasses to generate the colors

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

blocks.text: What is ready and about to come out into actual revelation can still be one unity and inclusion, as with seeing and hearing.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

blocks.text: The actual sights and sounds that came out are distinct and really different, and that difference is true. Looked at as things that were ready to come out with that potential, they are united within the essence.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

blocks.text: From the point of view of the essence, which far transcends these expressions, the expression does not yet exist. The essence also includes the ability to take these forms and filter itself into limited ways.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

blocks.text: So we see both sides: the essence transcends everything, like the power of movement, and the essence contains the distinctions and really permeates them. Those distinctions are real, because they come from its choice, and the essence chooses to be limited in a certain way. So from its perspective they are not yet there and not separate from it.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3
