blocks.text: We can speak of a unity of many distinct powers and experiences only from the point of view of what will come out. Since we know what came out, we can say those things were already there in potential, and so speak of them as distinct and united.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

blocks.text: So all the details that come out in the manifestation must have existed in the essence, united. Where else would they come from? The essence is the only source generating them.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

blocks.text: Now another *mashal*, to see how all of these fit together: the sun and the light of the sun. The sun is the luminary, then comes the general white light, then all the particular rays, which can be separated out through glasses of different colors to make the colors.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

blocks.title: The sun and its light

blocks.text: In the essence of the sun the light is not yet light; there is only the ability to create it, so you cannot speak of different colors being united there, since the whole concept of light does not exist yet. When the light is first created it appears as one general white light that includes them all. Then it is filtered out to reveal the particular things that were already there within it.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

blocks.text: So here are three things, and they set up the three aspects of the essence: the true essence itself, the transcendent thing, like the body of the sun; and two modes of expression, like a *makif* and a *pnimi*: the general, transcendent thing, represented by the white light, and the particular diverse expressions, represented by the *ziv*, the ray.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

blocks.text: So far, after all these *meshalim*: the *yechida* is the way we can experience an essence within ourselves. To appreciate it, three more: the power of movement, for how all the expressions are equal and one (the *makif*); the power of seeing and hearing, for the *pnimi*, where the distinctions do exist within the self and are not only created from outside; and the light of the sun, which shows the three stages.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

blocks.text: The seeing and hearing show that the essence gives the distinctions real existence, even though from the essence's perspective they are not diversity within it. The sun's light shows the three stages, which we now spell out.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

sections.title: The three stages of an essence: yachid, echad and kadmon
sections.summary: Within the essence there are three stages: the ten essential powers, their readiness to be revealed, and their complete preparation before they come into action.

phrases.he: ונמצא ג' מדריגות זה אחר זה נמשך מעצמיות הנפש ממש, הנקרא בחינת יחידה
phrases.en: so now we're going to spell that out: from the perspective of the essence of the soul, we have three stages

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

blocks.text: The three stages are not three parts of the soul. They are the way our minds pull an essence apart so that we can speak of it. An essence has three things: the core essence, and its expression in two ways, the transcendent and the one that permeates everything. These are the three aspects.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

phrases.he: הא' י' כחות עצמיים והיוליים, כמו חפץ חסד העצמי והיולי וכהאי גוונא
phrases.en: first there are the ten essential powers, part and parcel with the soul itself, like the essential ability of kindness

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

phrases.he: כלולים בה בתכלית, כהתכללות כח התנועה בעצם החי וכהתכללות התפשטות החיות בעצם כנזכר לעיל
phrases.en: and so those are completely one within the essence, like the power of movement

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

phrases.he: ולא יתכן בהם לומר לשון התאחדות מדברים נבדלים יחד
phrases.en: you can't speak of the ten *kochos* of the soul as being separate things; it's not like the soul is put together from these ten

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

phrases.he: אחר שכלולים לגמרי בעצם,
phrases.en: because their existence is completely one with the essence

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

phrases.he: והיה כלא היה במציאות כלל וכלל כנזכר לעיל
phrases.en: and so from this perspective the other things do not really exist

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

blocks.text: The first stage, which is again our primary *mashal*: the ten essential powers are part and parcel of the soul itself, such as the essential ability of kindness, of *gevura*, of *netzach*, of *malchus*.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

blocks.text: These are completely one within the essence, as the power of movement is one within the living being. The difference between kindness and *gevura* is irrelevant from that view, as is the difference among the expressions of consciousness.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

blocks.text: So they are both the same to the soul and different. Choosing to express oneself in kindness or in *gevura* involves no real difference for the essence, which can express itself equally well in either. Yet once one does choose, each expression has its own flavor and advantage, and that difference is real and valid. From the essence's perspective, though, they are really the same.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

blocks.text: You cannot speak of the ten *kochos* of the soul as separate things, as if the soul were put together from ten parts. Because their existence is completely one with the essence, from that perspective it is really just the essence, and by its nature it can do kindness, *gevura*, *chachma*, *netzach* and *malchus*. It is hard to grasp the nature of our essence, our *yechida*, which is why we have these other *meshalim*.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

blocks.text: From this perspective the other things do not really exist. It is just the essence of the soul, the *yechida*, which is what it is. By its nature it is able to create kindness and express itself that way, but that has no independent existence there yet. That is the first stage.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

phrases.he: והב' בחינת התפשטות י' כחות שמוכנים לבא בבחינת גלוי
phrases.en: the second stage is once the soul is ready to express itself, so it has decided, I want to do a kindness, or a *gevura*, or *netzach*, or *malchus*; at this point it is ready to express itself in these ten forms

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

phrases.he: כמו חפץ חסד העצמי ההיולי שבא לדבר חסד בדרך פרט
גם קודם שנמשך בפועל ממש,
רק כשעתיד ומוכן לצאת לדבר פרט
phrases.en: it is just ready and destined and there is that general commitment to make it happen, but the details are not there yet

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

phrases.he: שם יתכן ענין האחדות מכמה פרטים שבו
phrases.en: there you could discuss, for example, with kindness, that all the details that are needed to make this kindness happen are included in that one commitment

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

phrases.he: כמו שכל ומדות שבחפץ חסד זה הנמשך מהעלמות ההיולי הכללי כו'.
phrases.en: for example, the intellect and the emotions of this desire to do kindness, which are going to be drawn out from this essence of the *hiyuli*

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

blocks.text: The soul is shown its particular mission, and the sparks it has to refine, as we talked about in *Behaloscha*. The fact that G-d wants it to come down into this world gives it the general form of the ten *kochos*, and now it chooses to take on that form to fulfill its mission.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

blocks.text: At this point the soul commits to plugging into these ten *kochos*, but exactly how it will express them is still to be determined. It is like being told you will play a game, with its rules, but still needing to work out the strategy. The soul knows it needs to come down and use these ten to do its mission; what kind of kindness, what kind of *gevura*, how it plays out is not yet set.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

blocks.text: This is the ten *kochos* ready to be revealed, like the kindness that is there even before it comes out in actuality. Take Avraham: he wanted to do kindness and was looking for the opportunity at the door of his tent, and was ready, but the details of how to express it were not yet there. The general desire is ready and destined, with the commitment to make it happen.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

blocks.text: The details that the kindness will need are all included in that one general desire and commitment. You know the details will be needed, and they are all contained in the one general desire.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

blocks.text: This is the intellect and emotion of the desire to do kindness, which are drawn out from this essence of the *hiyuli*. Here they can be spoken of as many details, but they are united. This is what *Chassidus* often calls a *klal* for a *prat*: a general desire aimed at something specific, so the details must be part of it.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

blocks.text: If I ask you to make a cup, I do not care what material, what size or what color, but it will have to have a certain material, a certain size and a certain color. Those details are relevant, and they have to happen. If I just say "go do something," the details need not come out this way, and if you do not want to make anything, you do not have to commit to any details at all.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

blocks.title: The cup

blocks.text: So once there is a desire or a commitment that connects to some *prat*, before the details are worked out, the details will have to follow. That is the second stage.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

phrases.he: והג' כשנמשך ובא לאותו דבר פרט, רק שעדיין לא בא מצד העדר ומניעה
phrases.en: the third stage is when you have already completely committed to the details, you are ready to do it, and it just hasn't happened yet because something is in the way

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

phrases.he: אבל ההכנה בעצמה כבר בשלימותה, ולא חסר רק לבא בהתגלות בפועל ממש
phrases.en: the internal preparation within yourself is all complete; it just has to happen

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

phrases.he: דהיינו שכבר שיער היטב בעצמו בדרך פרט לאותו דבר שבא לפועל ממש
phrases.en: you've already made all the internal preparation; you've estimated and decided within yourself exactly what you want to do

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

phrases.he: והיינו שיער בעצמו בכח מה שצריך להביא בפועל
phrases.en: that within yourself you've estimated and calculated what you need to do in order to bring this thing to fruition

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

blocks.text: The third stage: you are completely committed to the details and ready to do it; it has not happened only because something in the way holds it back. As far as your inner preparation goes, you know exactly what you want to do; you have the training, and as soon as it is ready, you will do it.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

blocks.text: The inner preparation is complete; it only has to happen. Take someone new to a game such as basketball, or to a new art form or hobby: he knows what he wants to happen but not how to make it happen. He has to practice and be trained, to learn to bring out the details and build the *kelim*. He has the general desire and knows the target, but not the details.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

blocks.text: Here we are speaking of someone completely ready, like Avraham, who had planned the meal in his mind: the tongue, the mustard, all of it. He was unable to give the bread because of an outside circumstance, but that was part of his plan; it was ready and he knew exactly what he wanted to do.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

blocks.text: So within yourself you have estimated and calculated what needs to be done to bring this to fruition and actually do it.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

sections.title: Examples of the three stages, and what comes before action
sections.summary: The examples show the state before an action: a general unity that includes all its details, the practice that gives the details, and the change from potential to physical that needs tzimtzum.

phrases.he: כמו על דרך דוגמא הנזכר לעיל בכח התנועה כשעתידה לצאת בגלוי בדבר פרט
phrases.en: for example, the power of movement, when you are ready to make a certain motion: you know you are going to learn a new game, and you want to throw the ball in the hoop, but you don't know how to do it yet

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

phrases.he: וכמו התפשטות החיות להחיות לגוף כשמוכן לצאת
שכלולים שם ביחוד כללי כל החיות פרטיי'
phrases.en: so at that point it is a general unity that includes all the details, and all the details of what you are going to have to move are included in this general desire to get from here to there

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

blocks.text: Take the power of movement, when it is ready to come out into a particular motion. You know what you want to accomplish, but you do not yet have the preparation. The same is true of the power of consciousness: when it is ready to enliven the body.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

blocks.text: Here it is still a general consciousness. It is going to enter the eye and the ear, but at this point the eyes are closed and no sensations come, and it remains a general consciousness.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

blocks.text: At that point it is a general unity that includes all the details: all that you will have to move is in the one general desire to get from here to there. But how hard to pull each muscle takes practice. The general consciousness must enter the eye and the ear and receive the stimulus that turns it into specific experiences.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

phrases.he: ואח"כ הוא מה ששיער והכין כבר בכח התנועה איך להניע דרך פרט
phrases.en: then there is when a person has already practiced and prepared himself how to do a certain motion

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

phrases.he: וכן מה ששיער התגלות התפשטות רוח החיים, והוכן בו מה שעתיד להחיות בפועל ממש
phrases.en: the general consciousness is already prepared and it is ready, so what you are actually going to experience is prepared in it

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

phrases.he: וכמו כן דמיון כח הצומח כשמוכן להצמיח בפועל ממש,
phrases.en: similarly, with the metaphor of the power of growth, when it is ready to grow

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

phrases.he: שיש בזה גם כן ענין ג' מדריגות הללו
phrases.en: the soil has enough nutrients in it, it's moistened with water, and you have a seed that's put in there, and that seed is healthy and it's ready to germinate

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

blocks.text: Then there is the person who has practiced and prepared how to do a certain motion. He knows exactly how to do it and can execute it every time, like someone who learns to juggle: at first he does not know how, and after practice he knows exactly how hard to throw, but he is not actually doing it yet.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

blocks.text: The general consciousness is already prepared, and what it will actually experience is prepared in it. Athletes and musicians often practice by imagining themselves doing it, and that helps make the internal preparation. Much of the preparation is internal, rehearsed inside. So there is a difference between these two levels.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

blocks.text: The change from before you do it to after you do it needs something holding it back, and so the mashal helps us understand the need for *tzimtzum*. The next chapter gives the *nimshal*, and chapters 12 and 13 deal with the *tzimtzum*. This last mashal is preparing for that.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

blocks.question: Why this last mashal?

blocks.text: Take the power of growth: the soil has enough nutrients, it is moistened with water, a healthy seed is in it and ready to germinate, the temperature is right, and there is light. You have the same three stages here, and all three come before the thing actually happens.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

phrases.he: והכל הוא טרם שבא הדבר עדיין בפועל ממש
phrases.en: and all three of these stages are before it actually happens

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

phrases.he: כמו התנועה קודם שבאה בגשם הנפעל או החיות הרוחני קודם שבא בגשם הגוף
phrases.en: just like the power of movement before you actually moved your physical body, or the spiritual consciousness before it enters the body

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

phrases.he: ששם משתנה ממהות רוחנית למהות גשם, שהוא בחינת תנועה גשמיות
phrases.en: at that moment, when it goes from the potential, which is the preparation within yourself, to actualizing it, it goes from something spiritual to something physical. It is a complete change of nature

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

phrases.he: והחיות גשמיות וכהאי גוונא בגשם הצמיחה כו'
phrases.en: and the same thing with the physical growth of the actual plant

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

phrases.he: שצריך לזה בחינת צמצום וכיווץ בגלוי זה הרוחני בתחלה, כדי שיבוא מכלל רוחניות לגשמיות (כמו שיתבאר באות הי''ב):
phrases.en: in order to make that jump from spiritual potential to physical, it requires a special *tzimtzum* and contraction

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

blocks.text: The recap's last point about chapter 9: it is not enough to see the unity and that G-d is present everywhere. Then we would feel that G-d changes, and we would picture G-d too physically. So we need the *tzimtzum* at every stage: the essence is unchanging, and all the change and diversity we see come only through the light filtered through the *tzimtzum*.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 057 ch 10 intro recap.mp3

blocks.outOfPlace: Recap of chapter 9 given before chapter 10 is read; it sets up the tzimtzum at every stage.

blocks.text: After the *tzimtzum* there are changes, while the essence that is there remains present and unchanging. These are the checklist of things to keep in mind, intellectually and emotionally, to succeed in this book and in *Chassidus* and in the service of G-d.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 057 ch 10 intro recap.mp3

blocks.outOfPlace: Recap of chapter 9 given before chapter 10 is read; it sets up the tzimtzum at every stage.

blocks.text: The soil is an essence higher than the things that grow in it; it has its own existence and reality, and one thing it can do is grow things. A pot or a plot of soil can grow anything; it depends on the seed put in it. The particular seed channels that vast potential into something specific, and without a seed it stays as spiritual potential.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

blocks.text: The same is true of a person: he can have all the ability, even be trained, but he has to choose to do it. There has to be the choice to limit yourself from all you can do and all you know, and pick the one thing you will do. That is like putting the seed in the ground.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

blocks.text: So the spiritual power of movement before you move, or the spiritual consciousness before it enters the body, changes from something spiritual into something physical when it enters the body. It becomes an actual physical movement, a physical, biological, chemical process, and no longer depends on the choice.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

blocks.text: Some scientists look at the physical processes and conclude that there is no choice. They see that signals in the brain can show a movement about half a second before it is made. But that is the choice made in the soul first being processed in the physical brain, and then becoming the movement. Before you are aware of what you chose, the choice is already happening at a subconscious level. They see only the external physical process, translated from an inner spiritual choice.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

sensitivity.reason: Criticizes scientists, as a group, for reasoning that there is no choice from brain signals.
sensitivity.publishable: Some people look at the physical processes and conclude that there is no choice. They see that signals in the brain can show a movement about half a second before it is made. But the choice made in the soul is first processed in the physical brain, and then becomes the movement. Before you are aware of what you chose, the choice is already happening at a subconscious level. What they see is the external physical process, translated from an inner spiritual choice.

blocks.text: The physical sensation, through the nerves of the eyes and the ears and the process in the brain that goes with it, must be attached to the soul. Otherwise the body would be just dirt, unable to have consciousness and sensation.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

blocks.text: When the plant actually grows, all that potential is channeled into one particular plant, and that is what it is. That change gives a clue to the idea of before and after the *tzimtzum*.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

blocks.text: Going from spiritual potential to the physical thing requires *tzimtzum* and contraction, to make that jump. Think of someone at the edge of the diving board who is scared to jump: the potential is all in him, and he has to make the choice to focus it and take the one action.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

blocks.text: Any time one goes from spiritual potential to the physical act, it needs a special *tzimtzum*: in a person, a special choice to make the transition. That will be explained in chapter 12.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 060 ch 10 part 3.mp3

blocks.text: A checklist from the first nine chapters, applied to this chapter: the length, width and depth of *binah*, *chachma* and *daas*.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 061 ch 10 recap and extension.mp3

blocks.outOfPlace: Recap or extension given outside the reading of the lines: it is about the chapter as a whole, so it sits under the chapter's last passage.

blocks.text: What this chapter is about is seeing the relation of an essence to its expressions. For now we look for it in ourselves, in the *yechida*, and in other things. It should be relatable and something we can experience directly, because we see it in ourselves.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 061 ch 10 recap and extension.mp3

blocks.outOfPlace: Recap or extension given outside the reading of the lines: it is about the chapter as a whole, so it sits under the chapter's last passage.

blocks.text: The Tzemach Tzedek, as a small child, sat on his father's lap, as he tells it, stroking his beard and calling "Zaidy, Zaidy." The Alter Rebbe pointed to his arm, his hand, his head, his beard, asking "Is this Zaidy?" Each time: no, that is Zaidy's arm, and so on. "So where is Zaidy?" The child got off the lap, pretended he had hurt himself, and called out "Zaidy"; when the grandfather turned, he pointed and said, "There is Zaidy." The real essence of a person is none of the external parts; those are the vessels it is expressed through. A child can grasp this, and from it we can generalize.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 061 ch 10 recap and extension.mp3

blocks.outOfPlace: Recap or extension given outside the reading of the lines: it is about the chapter as a whole, so it sits under the chapter's last passage.
blocks.title: Where is Zaidy?

blocks.text: For width, see this in each of our *kochos*: the essence of kindness, of justice, of curiosity, of wanting to win and overcome challenges. Each is a single point beyond its details.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 061 ch 10 recap and extension.mp3

blocks.outOfPlace: Recap or extension given outside the reading of the lines: it is about the chapter as a whole, so it sits under the chapter's last passage.

blocks.text: An essence has two aspects. It unites all the details: it is higher than all of them and is their common theme. And it permeates each one, giving each detail a special value that nothing else has.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 061 ch 10 recap and extension.mp3

blocks.outOfPlace: Recap or extension given outside the reading of the lines: it is about the chapter as a whole, so it sits under the chapter's last passage.

blocks.text: Everyone wants to be happy, to win, to be kind, in many different ways. We should see the commonality that unites us, and also the value in each flavor. That is why we cannot do everything, and why it is valuable to have all different types of people.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 061 ch 10 recap and extension.mp3

blocks.outOfPlace: Recap or extension given outside the reading of the lines: it is about the chapter as a whole, so it sits under the chapter's last passage.

blocks.text: The second item is *tevuna*, the application. Every person's essence is pure. It is beyond what we do, our choices, what we understand or feel, beyond *sechel*, *middos* and *machshava*, *dibur* and *maaseh*, so no flaw in those lower levels can defile it. So we should not judge ourselves or others by those lower aspects. Each person has an inner, intrinsic G-dly value, a little piece of G-d from above, and that spark has this value no matter what.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 061 ch 10 recap and extension.mp3

blocks.outOfPlace: Recap or extension given outside the reading of the lines: it is about the chapter as a whole, so it sits under the chapter's last passage.

blocks.text: The second application is unity. When I look into my essence, I see that these G-d-given characteristics are the same as everyone else's; the real differences are circumstances, upbringing, habits and choices. So I should feel as *Moshe Rabbeinu* did, the most humble of all people, who did not consider himself better even than a non-Jewish idolater, because if that person had my upbringing and abilities, he might have done better. This is not a calculation. It is the sense of sameness: you see yourself in another person's eyes, and them in yours, and only outer circumstances separate you.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 061 ch 10 recap and extension.mp3

blocks.outOfPlace: Recap or extension given outside the reading of the lines: it is about the chapter as a whole, so it sits under the chapter's last passage.

blocks.text: We describe great *tzaddikim* by terms that do not capture who they are. The Rebbe, looking at the simplest Jew, even a sinner, sees an essential greatness: G-d created him, and he is literally a piece of G-d. So he sees more greatness, with more awe, in the lowest person than we see in the greatest *tzaddik*. We must train ourselves to look that way. This is the *ahavas Yisroel* of the *Baal Shem Tov*.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 061 ch 10 recap and extension.mp3

blocks.outOfPlace: Recap or extension given outside the reading of the lines: it is about the chapter as a whole, so it sits under the chapter's last passage.

blocks.text: It goes beyond people to everything. The *Baal Shem Tov* loved nature and saw G-dliness in everything, even rocks, plants and animals. The *Frierdiker Rebbe*'s memoirs tell how Liubavitch was founded by Meir, a man who loved nature and loved all people, Jews and gentiles alike. The village became known as a city of love, because it was founded on love for all. Seeing that inner, essential value brings this unity and love.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 061 ch 10 recap and extension.mp3

blocks.outOfPlace: Recap or extension given outside the reading of the lines: it is about the chapter as a whole, so it sits under the chapter's last passage.
blocks.title: Liubavitch and the lover of nature

blocks.text: The other side is diversity. Each person or creature expresses the essence in a unique way that no one else does, so one cannot measure one against another. Which is better, this color or that? It does not make sense. There is no hierarchy. In the days of *Moshiach* each person will envy his fellow, but not as competitive jealousy: a deeper appreciation of what the other has and we do not, as *Hayom Yom* describes it for the four questions of the *seder*. This is the *tevuna*, applied to our *avoda*.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 061 ch 10 recap and extension.mp3

blocks.outOfPlace: Recap or extension given outside the reading of the lines: it is about the chapter as a whole, so it sits under the chapter's last passage.

blocks.text: Now *kelal* and *prat*. The big picture is the *yechida*, the general essence, the G-dly spark that is the same in everything. We must then look at the unique way that the essence is expressed on each level, as *chesed* and *gevura* are within us, in every creature. *Moshiach* reveals the *yechida* in every single thing, as the *Kuntres* explains, and when the *yechida* is revealed on all the levels, the unique qualities come out: *Chassidus* enhancing the understanding of *pshat*, *remez*, *drush* and *sod*, the Torah revealed, and G-dliness revealed.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 061 ch 10 recap and extension.mp3

blocks.outOfPlace: Recap or extension given outside the reading of the lines: it is about the chapter as a whole, so it sits under the chapter's last passage.

blocks.text: We appreciate the big picture of the essence, the *yechida*, and also how that essence looks when it is plugged in on each level. It looks different on the level of *Asiya*, or *pshat*, than on the level of *Beriya* and of *drush*. The *Kuntres* is a good road map for seeing how to do that.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 061 ch 10 recap and extension.mp3

blocks.outOfPlace: Recap or extension given outside the reading of the lines: it is about the chapter as a whole, so it sits under the chapter's last passage.

blocks.text: Chapter 5 says to keep two sides in mind: the *ayin* and the *yesh*, the abstract thing we cannot know and the concrete thing we can. The essence is not something we can know. The *Alter Rebbe*, in a beautiful *maamar*, says that even our own soul's essence we do not know: we know we are alive, we experience it intimately, and yet we do not understand it. Anything on the level of *yechida* is inherently unknowable.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 061 ch 10 recap and extension.mp3

blocks.outOfPlace: Recap or extension given outside the reading of the lines: it is about the chapter as a whole, so it sits under the chapter's last passage.

blocks.text: We can experience it, and see its tangible impact. Touch something hot and you feel the heat: you know there is an idea of heat there, but not what its essence is. Life versus death, seeing, hearing, moving and responding are practical expressions of the essence, and so is the burn of heat on the skin, but what the essence is lies beyond our direct knowledge.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 10/Shaar HaYichud 061 ch 10 recap and extension.mp3

blocks.text: Throughout the universe, physical and spiritual, we quickly reach the edge of human knowledge. Nobody really knows what consciousness is; they see its effects. Nobody knows the essence of gravity, of light, or of an electron. We know how they interact with things and make models for their reactions, but there is a wall, a curtain, behind which the essence is unknown: like a king behind a curtain whom the people never see, hearing only his messages, or his voice. We do not know another person's inside, nor even our own essence. *Chassidus* reveals the *Ein Sof* that is in the *Reisha d'lo yada*, the head that is not known: recognizing the unknowable essence behind everything and how it plugs in. That is the distinction between *ayin* and *yesh*.

blocks.text: Chapter 6 gives two feelings, humility and accomplishment. Humility: we can never know the true depth of what is inside us, and we cannot judge others' inside. The *Baal Shem Tov* taught that there is unlimited potential in every person, as there is in the ground, and we should not limit it because someone is not learned or not so religious. We can give ourselves and others the tools and opportunities to develop it, which is the *yesh*. We should be proud of accomplishments in understanding, in *middos*, and in action, and keep flexibility, because we know there is an essence behind it.

blocks.text: Chapter 7 is the unity of the *makif*, the essence revealed and uniting everything, so that from that perspective all is the same. That is the unity of Shavuos, when all Israel camped at Sinai *k'ish echad b'lev echad*, like one man with one heart. But that unity is a little shallow, because it ignores the details of our individuality. Chapter 8 is the unity of the *pnimi*, the unity within the details: *Rosh Hashanah*'s "you stand here today, all of you," leaders and elders down to the woodchoppers and the water carriers, like the parts of one body.

blocks.text: Each part of the body is different and each has its own contribution, and they all need each other. From one perspective the head is on top; from another, the foot is superior, and there is no real way to say which is higher. What is an advantage from one side is a disadvantage from another. Sometimes it is good to be tall, sometimes short; sometimes smart, sometimes not. Each gives advantages in different situations. Seeing this gives a deeper, practical sense of unity.
